title: Minerift
description: Minerift is a free Minecraft server hosting network.
body:
Minerift is a free Minecraft server hosting network that lets you join and play on player-created servers.

You can connect to the Minerift Lobby at minerift.gg, then you can explore the lobby and hang out, or join a server:

Use <server>.minerift.gg to connect directly from your server list
Or run /join <server> in the lobby
